luna_art_direction.art_direction_ar: توجيه جرافيكي محلي للآية كعنصر طباعي مركزي، من دون إنشاء صورة مولدة أو تجسيد الأمر أو المأمور.

cinematic_blueprint.action: Reveal the approved verse as the only moving graphic element above a visually suspended horizon; increase typographic clarity through controlled opacity and luminance, synchronized with narration timing.
cinematic_blueprint.atmosphere: Severe, reverent, minimal, and contemplative; the graphic floats within symbolic darkness without depicting any unseen agent.
cinematic_blueprint.camera: Use authored 2.5D compositing with a very slow axial approach created by layered depth translation, not a template zoom; maintain the SEQ-08 right-to-left screen logic and a stable horizon.
cinematic_blueprint.color_palette: Cold black-blue background, luminous white typography, restrained warm parchment edge tone, and minimal antique-gold residual light.
cinematic_blueprint.composition: Place one approved verse block slightly right of center within monumental negative space, leaving clear breathing room; horizon forms a low secondary layer; typography is the sole visual focus.
cinematic_blueprint.continuity: SEQ-08; symbolic heavenly-unseen domain; key direction represented by a subtle frame-right luminance gradient; right-to-left sequence direction; palette and material language locked to the sequence reference pack.
cinematic_blueprint.environment: A composited suspended horizon with faint natural atmospheric texture, not a literal celestial realm; no generated landscape replacement.
cinematic_blueprint.lens: Not applicable to local graphics; simulate a restrained 2.5D perspective through calibrated layer separation only.
cinematic_blueprint.lighting: White text emerges through soft luminance rather than glow bloom; maintain cool blue-black field with a controlled frame-right light bias.
cinematic_blueprint.materials: Matte deep-blue atmospheric background, faint parchment grain, crisp off-white glyphs, and restrained antique-gold micro-accent; avoid metallic text.
cinematic_blueprint.safety: Use only the exact approved verse supplied by editorial; do not invent, paraphrase, translate, or alter sacred text. Do not depict Allah, prophets, angels, Iblis, Adam, or any unseen agent; no symbolic figure, face, body, or illustrative icon.
cinematic_blueprint.subject: The approved verse typography as the single graphic subject.
cinematic_blueprint.temporal_motion: 0–5 seconds: horizon and atmospheric layers remain nearly still while the verse fades in at low opacity; 5–13 seconds: glyph clarity increases through a controlled luminance ramp synchronized to narration, with no letter morphing; 13–18 seconds: typography reaches stable readability and holds without a freeze-filler feel. Use precise kerning, baseline stability, no jitter, no random particles, no decorative motion, and no template zoom.

subtitle_ar: توجيه جرافيكي محلي للآية كعنصر طباعي مركزي، من دون إنشاء صورة مولدة أو تجسيد الأمر أو المأمور.
